title: Multi-source collection quests re-list a source you just completed as still outstanding. After reading the headland markers outright, 'Names for the Rite' said 'One source found. Two remain: Ede's memory, the parish roll, the headland's markers' (re-listing the headland markers you just read). After the ring-ditch verse, 'Three Old Verses' said 'One verse known. Two more wait: the ring-ditch, the king's causeway, the mere-stone' (re-listing the ring-ditch you just read).
where: The Furrow's Headland (Fallows) 'read the markers outright' / The Ring-Ditch (Hollowbrook) 'read the ring-ditch script'
